What we do

Logistics Solutions for Your High-Performance Supply Chain

We provide freight, customs compliance, warehousing, and analytics, backed by adaptable capabilities tailored to evolving business requirements.

Freight Bill Audit & Payment

We identify billing discrepancies and carrier overcharges early, improving cost control and strengthening supply chain efficiency across your freight operations.

End-to-End Track & Trace

KGS provides around-the-clock shipment tracking, proactive exception management, and timely updates to keep deliveries visible, responsive, and on schedule.

Customs Brokerage Support

At KGS, we offer accurate logistics documentation, tariff classifications, and duty calculations to maintain compliance, reduce border delays, and keep shipments moving.

Order Management

We manage orders from purchase through confirmation with accuracy and visibility, maintaining organized workflows and consistent fulfillment as volumes grow.

Bill of Lading Processing

We digitize, validate, and structure bills of lading to improve data accuracy, maintain reliable records, and support downstream logistics processes.

EDI Transaction Management

Our EDI transaction management services ensure reliable data exchange across trading partners, detect discrepancies early, and maintain seamless system communication.

Customer & Carrier Support

We provide multilingual support for shippers, carriers, and consignees, resolving queries quickly and keeping shipments moving without unnecessary operational delays.

Supply Chain Analytics

We transform shipment data into actionable insights through carrier dashboards, cost analyses, and KPI reporting to support informed supply chain decisions.

Powered by the Right Technology. Driven by the Right Expertise.

From automating repetitive tasks to forecasting delays and optimizing routes, KGS applies AI where it delivers measurable business value. Our solutions enable faster decision-making, improve operational performance, reduce inefficiencies, and build more resilient, responsive supply chain.

Why Us

24/7 Logistics Support

Our specialists provide round-the-clock logistics support across every time zone, ensuring uninterrupted service for businesses that rely on time-sensitive logistics.

Platform Expertise

We work confidently in CargoWise, Manhattan, MercuryGate, and SAP from day one, supporting modern transportation solutions across complex supply chain environments.

Exception Management

KGS identifies and addresses potential delays, discrepancies, and service interruptions early, before they impact customers or business performance.

Accuracy Driven

We minimize customs and billing errors through disciplined processes, reducing delays, penalties, and avoidable logistics costs.

Scalable Capacity

KGS scales resources to support seasonal demand, new trade lanes, and business growth through cost-effective logistics process outsourcing.

Cost Recovery

Freight audit specialists identify carrier overcharges and recover costs that often exceed the investment made in the engagement.

Faster Cycles

Our logistics specialists streamline workflows to shorten order-to-delivery timelines and improve efficiency throughout the transportation network.

Complete Transparency

We deliver weekly reports on turnaround times, accuracy, exceptions, and performance metrics, giving stakeholders complete visibility into logistics performance.
